title: API Key Input Binding
requirements: Add a local @State var apiKeyInput: String to SettingsView to buffer the field text; the SecureField binds to apiKeyInput, not to the Keychain-backed getter
Commit apiKeyInput to Keychain only on .onSubmit, .onDisappear, or via an explicit Save button — never on every keystroke
Remove the per-keystroke SecItemDelete → SecItemAdd flow from TranscriptSettings.apiKey get/set; apiKey loads once on SettingsView .onAppear into apiKeyInput
On SettingsView .onDisappear, if apiKeyInput differs from the last-loaded value, commit to Keychain (defensive guard; no duplicate-clipboard-characters)
Do not log or display the API key in plaintext
acceptance_criteria: Typing smoothly into the API key field does not cause freezes, duplicated characters, or desync between display and buffer
The saved Keychain value matches what was typed after navigation-away or Save
No per-keystroke SecItem operation is visible in Instruments / Time Profiler
